name: Ancestral Arts Part 1: The Witch's Siren Song
source:
Mary Barker had a perfectly normal life, until a mental breakdown sent her spiraling into a rabbit hole of spiritual confusion.
When Shade, a bona fide witch, offered to teach her the art of witchcraft, Mary happily accepted.
Will this be the change that gives her life a purpose? What will she sacrifice as she walks the witch's path? And for how long will she be able to deny that she has a huge crush on her magical mentor...?

[From [url=https://jesscapade.itch.io/ancestral-arts-part-1]itch.io[/url]]
